universities.summary: Government Arts and Science College, Thiruvottiyur is a co-educational government college at Wimco Nagar in Chennai. Established in 2012, it offers undergraduate arts, commerce and computer-application study. These entries cover four verified academic degrees under the Tamil Nadu government admission framework.
universities.campusLifestyle: The college serves Thiruvottiyur and nearby communities from its Wimco Nagar campus. Its official site describes classroom study, student clubs, cultural activities, sports and community-service opportunities. Confirm the activities and academic arrangements available for the chosen subject when accepting an offer.
universities.cityProfile: The college is in Wimco Nagar, Thiruvottiyur, Chennai 600019, and uses gascthiruvottiyur.ac.in. The current government admission code is 1011010. It is distinct from Government Arts and Science College at Dr R.K. Nagar and from institutions at Thiruvennainallur with similar abbreviated names.
universities.practicalExposure: Commerce and Commerce with Computer Applications have different academic emphases. The college describes business-related study for the general Commerce degree and computing applications alongside commerce for the specialised route. Check the current curriculum and assessment requirements; a degree offer does not guarantee a placement or internship.
universities.hostelOverview: The 2026 government college booklet lists no college or welfare hostel accommodation. Plan commuting or independently verified housing and check any later change directly with the college. admissionsContent.overview: B.A. Tamil Literature is a regular three-year undergraduate programme at the college’s Wimco Nagar campus in Thiruvottiyur, Chennai.

eligibility.intro: The subject, ranking and age conditions follow the 2026 Tamil Nadu government-college admission framework.
items: Pass HSC/+2 or an accepted equivalent and satisfy the subject conditions for this regular first-year route.
For a language degree, ranking first considers applicants who studied that language under HSC Part III; remaining applicants are ranked using the applicable Part I or Part II language marks.
The upper age limit is 40 as on 1 July 2026.
Three-year relaxation may be allowed for women and SC/SCA/ST/BC/BCM/MBC/DNC categories; five years is permitted for disability/transgender categories, subject to assessment.
Relaxations are not automatically cumulative. Ranking, reservation, counselling and original-record verification determine admission.

faq.question: Which college is this?
faq.answer: This is Government Arts and Science College at Wimco Nagar, Thiruvottiyur, Chennai 600019, with current government admission code 1011010 and official domain gascthiruvottiyur.ac.in.

faq.question: Is the college co-educational?
faq.answer: The current government college booklet lists it as co-educational. These entries cover the verified regular domestic first-year route; separate overseas or advanced-entry conditions have not been established.

faq.question: Which degrees are included?
faq.answer: The entries cover B.A. Tamil Literature, B.A. English Literature, B.Com. Commerce and B.Com. Commerce with Computer Applications. Other listed programmes require their own admission and approval checks.

faq.question: How long are the degrees?
faq.answer: The college’s own named course pages specify three years for each of these academic undergraduate programmes.

faq.question: What subjects are needed?
faq.answer: Commerce routes require Commerce and Accountancy at HSC under the DCE framework. Language-degree ranking gives first consideration to the relevant HSC Part III language and then the applicable Part I or Part II language marks.

faq.question: What are the 2026 age rules?
faq.answer: The DCE upper age limit is 40 as on 1 July 2026. Specified category relaxations may apply, including three years for women and listed community categories or five years for disability/transgender categories. Confirm assessment; relaxations are not automatically cumulative.

faq.question: Which teaching languages are verified?
faq.answer: The current matrix explicitly marks the two Commerce programmes as English medium. The language-degree titles alone do not establish their teaching medium; confirm the arrangements directly.

faq.question: What fees should I budget for?
faq.answer: The own course pages refer to government fees without a numeric tariff. Request the complete current tuition and compulsory-charge list for the chosen programme and category, together with any separate costs.

faq.question: Is a hostel available?
faq.answer: The current government booklet lists no college or welfare hostel accommodation. Confirm any later change directly and plan commuting or independently verified housing.

faq.question: Does meeting the qualification guarantee admission?
faq.answer: No. Merit ranking, subject and category rules, available seats, counselling and original-document verification determine admission. An application or qualifying subject record alone does not establish an offer.
